people.name: Woon-Seng Gan
people.title: Professor; Director, Smart Nation TRANS Lab
people.affiliation: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, NTU Singapore
people.bio: Woon-Seng Gan is a Professor of Audio Engineering in the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at NTU Singapore, and Director of the Smart Nation TRANS Lab (evolved from the Texas Instruments DSP Elite Lab he leads). His research spans active noise control, AI for audio, soundscape augmentation, and spatial audio for hearables. He is an IEEE Distinguished Lecturer.

people.name: Ee-Leng Tan
people.title: Senior Research Fellow
people.affiliation: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering & Smart Nation TRANS Lab, NTU Singapore
people.bio: Ee-Leng Tan (Joseph) is a Senior Research Fellow in the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering and the Smart Nation TRANS Lab at NTU Singapore. His work focuses on machine learning for environmental audio — acoustic scene classification, sound event detection, and end-to-end IoT systems for urban sound sensing.

people.name: Jun-Wei Yeow
people.title: PhD Candidate
people.affiliation: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, NTU Singapore
people.bio: Jun-Wei Yeow is a PhD candidate in the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at NTU Singapore. His research develops data-centric and label-efficient deep learning for sound event localization and detection (SELD), spanning spatial-audio features, model architectures, 3-D SELD with distance estimation, and language interfaces to spatial perception.
